name: Checkbox / Terms Accepted
description: Terms Accepted product scenario for the Checkbox component.

props.label: I agree to the Terms of Service
props.name: terms

controls.name: checked
controls.description: Controlled selection. Indeterminate summarizes a partially selected collection; it does not submit a value.

controls.name: defaultChecked
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial selection, also restored by form reset.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible label content. Empty content adds no label slot; zero remains visible.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name, including when there is no visible label.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: External label element IDs; takes native precedence over aria-label.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Exclude the checkbox from activation, focus navigation and form submission.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require an actual checked value for native form validation; mixed is not checked.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key. Without a name the checkbox does not contribute a field.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Value submitted only when checked. It does not control selection.

controls.name: form
controls.description: ID of an external native form that owns the input.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the native input on mount.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Expand the membrane and clickable label to the container width.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing; toggling it preserves input identity and state.
